rationale: Jacob is building full-stack AI systems with a focus on agent infrastructure and physical robotics, while Anshu is establishing security frameworks specifically for AI agents and LLMs—creating a natural fit where Jacob's end-to-end AI development approach could benefit from Anshu's expertise in agent safety and exploitation prevention. Both are San Francisco-based founders working in complementary areas of the AI space, where Jacob's infrastructure and training systems (evolutionary algorithms, on-device AI) intersect with Anshu's mission to secure agent-based systems against vulnerability.
intro_message: Jacob Valdez, meet Anshu Gupta — you're both building critical infrastructure for AI agents in San Francisco, and Anshu's work securing and stress-testing agent systems could be valuable perspective for VibeStartup's full-stack approach.
